title_en: [VIDEO] Workers confess to giving dirty liquid in mosque, taking drugs
summary_en: PASIR MAS - A labourer pleaded guilty in the Magistrate Court here on Thursday to charges of treason by sprinkling a foul-smelling liquid onto carpets at a mosque in Tumpat. The defendant, Manjesh Singh Shukdev Singh, 38, also pleaded guilt for taking drugs.
